info.title: Healthcare Guidelines RAG Assistant
info.description:
Citation-first, evidence-validated question answering over guideline documents.

> ⚠️ All guideline content is **synthetic**. Not for clinical use.

post.summary: Answer a question with validated citations
post.description: Answer a question strictly from the indexed guidelines. Every answer is scored for evidential support; weakly supported answers are withheld with `status: needs_review` and the best candidate sources (ADR-0007). **Synthetic corpus — not for clinical use.**

post.summary: Alias of POST /api/v1/qa (path required by the project brief)
post.description: Answer a question strictly from the indexed guidelines. Every answer is scored for evidential support; weakly supported answers are withheld with `status: needs_review` and the best candidate sources (ADR-0007). **Synthetic corpus — not for clinical use.**

post.summary: Exchange email and password for tokens
Rotate the refresh token and issue a new access token
post.description: Reads the refresh token from the cookie or the body. Each refresh token works once; presenting a used one revokes the whole session (theft signal).

get.summary: Query volume, pass rate, confidence, latency and topics for a window
One query with evidence, signals, withheld candidate answer and review

get.description: `pending`: abstained queries nobody has reviewed yet. `reviewed`: queries with a review (filter by `verdict`). `all`: every abstained or reviewed query.

post.summary: Approve, reject or correct a query (re-posting updates the review)

get.summary: Promoted reviews as gold dev-set candidates (JSONL)
get.description: One JSON object per line in the `gold_source.yaml` item format, plus a `source` block for traceability. Candidates need an annotator pass before they join the gold set (DATASET_CARD.md).

post.summary: Start an evaluation of the dev pool (asynchronous)
post.description: Poll `GET /eval-runs/{id}` for the result. One run at a time (409). The held-out test split is never evaluated from the API (ADR-0001).

get.summary: One evaluation run with its full summary
Known index versions (newest first) and which one is active

post.summary: Verify, load and activate an index version (hot swap, audited)

get.summary: State of the last dev-only index rebuild

post.summary: Rebuild the index from the corpus (development only; asynchronous)
post.description: Builds into INDEX_STORE_DIR/<version>/ and registers the version; it does NOT activate it. Disabled in production, where CI builds index images (ADR-0008).

get.summary: Corpus inventory of the active index, with chunk counts

put.summary: Change runtime tuning (audited; other pods follow within CONFIG_POLL_SECONDS)

get.summary: Who changed what, when (filter by action prefix, actor, time)

AbstentionReason.title: AbstentionReason
AbstentionReason.description: Why an answer was withheld (ADR-0007). Ordered from most to least specific.

snippet.title: Snippet
snippet.description: Evidence text shown to the user.

score.title: Score
score.description: Normalised retrieval score of this chunk.

superseded.title: Superseded
superseded.description: The source document has been replaced by a newer version (ADR-0010).

loc.title: Loc
loc.description: Path to the offending field, e.g. ['body', 'top_k'].

FieldError.title: FieldError
FieldError.description:
One request-validation failure. The rejected input is deliberately NOT echoed
back, because a question may contain patient information (ADR-0009).

title.title: Title
title.description: Short, human-readable summary of the problem type.

errors.msg: Input should be less than or equal to 20

question.title: Question
question.description: Natural-language question about the indexed guidelines.

top_k.title: Top K
top_k.description: Number of evidence chunks to retrieve.

examples.question: When should health workers perform hand hygiene?

answer.title: Answer
answer.description: Extractive answer with [n] markers, or the abstention message.

status.description: `validated` only when confidence ≥ threshold and numeric_ok.

examples.answer: Perform hand hygiene before donning gloves and after removing them [1].

citations.snippet: Hand hygiene must be performed before donning gloves ...
citations.title: Glove Use in Health Care (synthetic)

candidate_answer.title: Candidate Answer
candidate_answer.description: Withheld low-confidence answer; visible to reviewers only (ADR-0007).

checks.title: Checks
checks.description: Per-dependency state: `index` (loaded and verified), `database` (`not_configured` when DATABASE_URL is unset).

RefreshRequest.title: RefreshRequest
RefreshRequest.description: Body is optional: browsers send the httpOnly cookie; other clients send the token.

promote_to_gold.title: Promote To Gold
promote_to_gold.description: Export this item as a gold dev-set candidate.

ReviewQueueItem.title: ReviewQueueItem
ReviewQueueItem.description: A row of the review queue: the query plus its review, if any.

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.description: Share of answer content tokens found in the cited evidence.

query_support.title: Query Support
query_support.description: Share of question key terms found in the cited evidence.

retrieval_score.title: Retrieval Score
retrieval_score.description: Normalised fused retrieval score of the cited chunks.

numeric_ok.title: Numeric Ok
numeric_ok.description: Every number/unit in the answer appears in its cited evidence.

Signals.title: Signals
Signals.description: The components of `confidence` (ADR-0002), exposed for transparency.

series.title: Series
series.description: One point per UTC day with queries.

TokenResponse.title: TokenResponse
TokenResponse.description:
`refresh_token` is also set as an httpOnly cookie scoped to /api/v1/auth. It is
returned in the body for non-browser clients; the SPA must ignore it (ADR-0008).

index_version.title: Index Version
index_version.description: Active index, or null if none is loaded.
